candidates.titulo: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
candidates.resumen: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.

candidates.titulo: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
candidates.resumen: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

candidates.titulo: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
candidates.resumen: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.
